# Torupro

> Torupro (BaMu Ehitus OÜ, reg. code 16986440) is a plumbing and sanitary-engineering company in Tallinn, Estonia. It provides 24/7 emergency plumbing, drain and sewer unblocking, high-pressure sewer jetting (survepesu), sewage/septic tank emptying (fekaalivedu), sewer camera inspection, leak detection, pipe and riser replacement and outdoor sewer construction in Tallinn and Harju County (Harjumaa). The website is available in Estonian (/et, default), English (/en) and Russian (/ru).

## Contact

- Phone (24/7, emergencies and bookings): +372 5679 2222
- Email: info@torupro.ee
- Address: Pae tn 20, 11414 Tallinn, Harjumaa, Estonia
- Service area: Tallinn and Harju County (Harjumaa), Estonia
- Opening hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Languages: Estonian, English, Russian
- Warranty: 2-year warranty on completed work (not applicable to blockage removal)

## Licences (Estonian Register of Economic Activities, MTR)

- Construction and plumbing work (Ehitustööd ja santehnilised tööd): EEH012495
- Electrical work (Elektritööd): TEL003775
- Gas work (Gaasitööd): TGT000755
- Verify in MTR: https://mtr.ttja.ee/majandustegevusteade?m=98

## Services

- [Plumbing Works in Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/torutood-tallinnas) (ET: [Torutööd Tallinnas](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/torutood-tallinnas)): Professional plumbing works in Tallinn and Harjumaa — installation, repair and maintenance, fast, guaranteed and transparent pricing.
- [Drain Unblocking Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/ummistuse-likvideerimine) (ET: [Kanalisatsiooni Ummistuse Likvideerimine](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/ummistuse-likvideerimine)): Fast drain unblocking in Tallinn — kitchen sink, WC, shower and pipes. On-site in 1–2 hours, 24/7.
- [High-Pressure Pipe Flushing Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/kanalisatsiooni-survepesu) (ET: [Kanalisatsiooni Survepesu Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/kanalisatsiooni-survepesu)): High-pressure water jet flushing of sewer pipes — fully removes grease, scale and root intrusion. Large and small jobs.
- [Pipe Camera Inspection Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/kaamerauuring) (ET: [Kanalisatsiooni Kaamerauuring](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/kaamerauuring)): Video inspection of pipes with a camera head — we find leaks, blockage causes and structural damage without digging.
- [Sewer Repair Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/kanalisatsiooni-remont) (ET: [Kanalisatsiooni Remont Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/kanalisatsiooni-remont)): Sewer pipe repair and replacement in Tallinn — fixing cracked, corroded and leaking pipes with quality materials.
- [Grease Trap Cleaning Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/rasvapuuduri-puhastus) (ET: [Rasvapüüduri Puhastus Tallinn](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/rasvapuuduri-puhastus)): Professional grease trap emptying and cleaning for restaurants, kitchens and food businesses. Regular maintenance keeps pipes problem-free.

Stormwater drainage in order, flooding prevented.
- [Emergency Plumber Tallinn 24/7](https://torupro.ee/en/teenused/torumees-tallinn-247) (ET: [Torumees Tallinn 24/7](https://torupro.ee/et/teenused/torumees-tallinn-247)): Emergency plumber in Tallinn around the clock — leaks, burst pipes, WC failures. On site within 1 hour.

Minimal noise and dust.
